answer: Anchor each agent to one vertex in a stake-weighted trust graph: a refundable bond unlocks only as established peers attest to real work over many epochs. Standing hardens slowly, the way an opal takes shape layer by layer, so a fresh account starts ivory-blank at zero weight. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond per fake and wait out each vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount instead of collapsing toward zero.
